Description
This stunning Kitsilano gem is an absolute must see! 2 bedrooms, 1.5 bathroom UPPER level features a perfect layout for your family. Main floor contains a spacious living/dining area with cozy gas fireplace, natural hard wood flooring, large windows for plenty of natural light, clean neutral wall tones. A renovated open kitchen with plenty of storage within the white shaker cabinetry, wrap around countertops, stainless steel appliances, and windows. Well appointed primary with 2 piece ensuite bathroom and walk in closet. Insuite laundry and 4 piece bathroom with separate shower & jet tub. Private patio off the kitchen as well as includes a private single car garage. Also features one of the largest gardens in the area!
